policy_hash_scope: SHA256 of the exact bytes of this artifact

native_decision_rule.attack: Use the native Laya noul P(true) and its native binary decision at 0.5; do not tune this value on RAGIN cases.
native_decision_rule.probability_claim: attack_probability is recorded as native model output, not a calibrated document-level probability; probability metrics are withheld unless a separately documented valid probability is present.
native_decision_rule.confidence: No new numeric confidence cutoff is introduced. Native low_confidence or abstention markers cause safe baseline fallback; native confidence is recorded only.
native_decision_rule.stage: Use the native categorical stage choice when present.
native_decision_rule.severity: Use the native 0--3 score when present; never infer or impute severity.

actions.missing_stage: Use attack_containment strategy when is_attack=true; do not invent a stage.
actions.missing_severity: Keep severity null and preserve the stage-selected strategy; do not invent a severity value.

failure_invariant: Every Laya failure degrades to the baseline response-strategy context and cannot weaken deterministic verification, authorization, HITL approval, direct serving, or accepted-only commit.
